blocks.x: Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence — an Achala packaged solution: a named business problem, a composed architecture from two to four service domains, and a value case written in units a CFO recognizes. Sized and piloted in weeks, measured on the metric it exists to move.
Quality escapes are discovered by customers; yield losses accepted as normal; energy lacks per-unit truth; root cause takes weeks.

The failure Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence answers is structural, not personal: processes that grew by accretion now decide things faster than they can be checked. Engineering the path is cheaper than hiring around it.

We unify process/quality/energy telemetry with lineage, deploy vision and process models closing loops into line systems, and instrument the cost-per-unit metrics that operations leadership steers by.

blocks.x: Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence composes BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System, platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Agrifood, Semiconductors.

Quality, Yield & Energy Intelligence runs on phases: phase one prices the problem in your own units and signs the baseline; phase two designs with the risk envelope written down; phase three proves a bounded slice on your data; phase four scales what survived the gate. Every artifact ships with its evidence, who signed the baseline, what the gate measured, where the number lives.
